text: Framework for building web UIs, aiming to be approachable, performant, and versatile
quote: An approachable, performant and versatile framework for building web user interfaces.

text: Ecosystem can be adopted incrementally, scaling from a small library to a full framework
quote: A rich, incrementally adoptable ecosystem that scales between a library and a full-featured framework.

text: Components are built with standard HTML, CSS, and JavaScript via an intuitive API
quote: Builds on top of standard HTML, CSS and JavaScript with intuitive API and world-class documentation.

text: Reactivity system uses a compiler-optimized renderer that rarely needs manual performance tuning
quote: Truly reactive, compiler-optimized rendering system that rarely requires manual optimization.
